name: Competition of Zomnivoilo Khell
benefit:
- Financial assistance towards production costs as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa from time to time.
- Mementos awarded to first three winning positions (no cash prizes).
- Video recording of all performances for preservation in Tiatr Academy of Goa library.
- Complimentary Digital Versatile Disc copy of the performance provided to the director.
- Platform for showcasing traditional Khell performan
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be an institution or individual organizing a Khell performance. - The applicant must have staged the Khell during the current carnival season. - The applicant must comply with the exact format of Zomnivoilo Khell comprising 8 to 10 songs called Cantos. - The applicant must ensure each canto consists of 2 verses and one chorus with limited dialogues. - The applicant must maintain the duration of each Khell between 40 to 60 minutes. - The applicant must ensure comedy in the Khell is related to the story. - The applicant must use traditional musical instruments including drums and two blowing instruments. - The applicant must ensure no adverse remarks are made against any governments, individuals, institutions, or anything against caste, creed, and religion. - Artists can participate in only one group and one Khell (except musicians who can participate in multiple Khells). - Mandatory attendance at discussion session on positive and negative aspects of performances. - No adverse remarks against any governments, individuals, institutions, or anything against caste, creed, and religion. - The three Khell troupes which won 1st, 2nd, and 3rd places in the previous competition receive direct entry provided they apply within stipulated time.
